description: Ω9 healing engine — the closed loop as ONE deterministic operation over supplied data: drift detection (promoted contract evidence signature vs fresh observation) → rediscovery (a DRAFT replacement candidate that must cite evidence) → probation (postcondition probes scored against the POLICY threshold) → promotion (≥ threshold with the required probe count) — the promote decision hands the replacement to the amendment transport (recipe re-compile + atomic pin swap, Ω0 host machinery). Consumes the discovery pipeline's DATA shapes (SurfaceContract / probe results) as tolerant plain JSON; imports no discovery-* code. Every healing event is journaled to the user's vault (ns 'discovery', id 'heal:<ts>') with the full evidence chain.

engine.doc: discovery.heal@1 {contractEvidence, freshObservation, candidate, probes, provider?, archetypeSlug?} → healing report. READ-class: engine contributions carry no risk attribute (risk is CONTRACT-kind declared data, per the pinned manifest law); this op mutates nothing except the journaled vault event, and the actual install is a separate user-signed recipe amendment. D-326: on drift the current-state realization record in ns 'providers' is appended (DEGRADED for reject, TESTING for hold-in-probation) via providerRealizationId(), superseding the prior rev and citing the drift observation; none/promote write no realization (verify owns promotion).

policy.doc: The healing policy, as versioned DATA (never code constants): driftThreshold — drift scores at or above this trigger rediscovery; probationProbes — the minimum probe count a probation report must carry; promotionThreshold — the probe pass-rate score promotion requires. Amendable by manifest change → recipe re-compile → atomic pin swap, exactly like any other plugin content.

capabilities.justification: Healing events are journaled into the USER'S VAULT (data/code divorce): ns 'discovery', id 'heal:<ts>', data = the healing report with the full evidence chain. D-326: the current-state realization record (ns 'providers', DEGRADED on drift / TESTING on probation entry) is appended alongside, reading the prior rev first for supersedes lineage and evidence carry-forward (port:vault.get@1). The composition grants exactly these per user-signed Recipe — never this manifest. Both writes are reported, never blocking the healing decision.
